methodology.primaryBody: largest 8-connected occupied component per frame, not stable particle IDs
methodology.brightEyeCandidate: all occupied pixels >=139; may vanish or overlap other light details
methodology.detachedMatter: all occupied pixels outside the primary component
methodology.holds: body center change <= 0.5px and full silhouette IoU >= 0.995
caveats: Source PNG does not encode time; durations are unknown without an explicit parameter.
Near-identical frames are not proof of duration or sustained stops.
The final frame cannot show what happens after the sequence ends.
Connected-component membership can change when parts touch or separate.
No stable particle identities or 11-region anatomical assignments can be deduced from these PNGs alone.
The source canvas is not the 200x200 runtime coordinate system; no crop or rescale has been applied.
